title: Summer Plans
instructions: Read the text. Fill in each gap (1–6) with ONE word from the box. You must use a word which is somewhere in the rest of the text. There are two extra words that you do not need.

blocks.title: Summer Plans
blocks.text:
I usually teach English at a language school in the summer. I often can't enjoy the (1) ______ because I am so busy. So next summer, I'm not planning to work. Instead, I'm going to have a proper summer holiday. I'm going to buy a campervan and drive around Ireland. I'm going to (2) ______ lots of beautiful beaches and learn to surf! I'm mostly going to travel alone, but I will visit friends. One friend, Cathy, is a school teacher, so she has a long summer (3) ______, so hopefully, we will spend a week or two together. Another Irish friend, Joe, has a new house there, so I'll stay with him for a few days and help him paint the rooms.

Last year, I did a surfing instructor course, and I spent the summer teaching people to (4) ______. It was great! I was in the sea and sun all day, and every evening, my friends and I had a barbecue on the beach. The surf school asked me to return this summer, (5) ______ I'm not going to do that. Last autumn, I learned to scuba dive, and I'm going to do diving (6) ______ course soon.

questions.why: «enjoy the summer» — matnning boshida «in the summer» deyilgan; yoz faslidan bahramand bo'la olmayapti.
«I'm going to visit lots of beautiful beaches» — 'to' dan keyin fe'l (visit) keladi.
«a long summer holiday» — maktab o'qituvchisining uzoq yozgi ta'tili.
«teaching people to surf» — surfing instructor kursi haqida gap ketyapti.
Qarama-qarshilik: «asked me to return, but I'm not going to» — 'but' kerak.
«diving instructor course» — oldin «surfing instructor course» deyilgan.
